Data mode: missing_data. Task quote: Plot one vertical bar per region in this left-to-right order: North, South, East, West. Include all four regions even if a region has no retained rows; its net revenue is then zero. Do not plot individual orders or include failed or pending orders. Location: South region bar. Expected: Bar with height 0 for South region. Observed: No bar for South region. Discrepancy: South region bar is missing from the plot, though it should be included with zero net revenue.
Data mode: wrong_order. Task quote: Plot one vertical bar per region in this left-to-right order: North, South, East, West. Include all four regions even if a region has no retained rows; its net revenue is then zero. Do not plot individual orders or include failed or pending orders. Location: Bar order. Expected: North, South, East, West. Observed: North, East, West (South missing). Discrepancy: Bars are in order North, South, East, West but South is missing, so the order is incorrect.
Data mode: wrong_selection. Task quote: Plot one vertical bar per region in this left-to-right order: North, South, East, West. Include all four regions even if a region has no retained rows; its net revenue is then zero. Do not plot individual orders or include failed or pending orders. Location: Regions plotted. Expected: All four regions: North, South, East, West. Observed: Only North, East, West. Discrepancy: The plot includes only three regions (North, East, West) but should include all four regions.

Data mode: wrong_values. Task quote: Using matplotlib, read cohorts.csv. Each row gives successes and attempts for one group in one month. For each month, compute the overall success rate as 100 times the sum of successes divided by the sum of attempts across that month's groups. Do not take the unweighted arithmetic mean of the groups' individual success percentages, and do not pool different months together. Location: Mar point value. Expected: 60.0%. Observed: 66.0%. Discrepancy: The chart shows 66.0% for Mar, but the correct pooled rate for Mar is 60.0%.
